name: QIDI PAHT-CF (PPA-CF) @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page: nozzle 300-320 C, bed 70-90 C (with glue), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.20, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 84.8 C unannealed / 190.7 C annealed, melt 237 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-6 h. QIDI blog/TDS: part cooling fan OFF (guide allows 0-50 %), retraction 1-3 mm @1800-3600 mm/min, 0.2 mm bimetal nozzle not recommended; QIDI BOX / PTFE multi-material feeding not recommended for this filament. Enclosure required; no chamber temperature published. Wiki engineering tips: dry 80 C >=8 h, anneal ~80 C 8 h.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-paht-cf-carbon-fiber-filament
